about: Every quote change, quote withdrawal and trade the v10 bot saw in its 10 live rounds against three figgie.com Hard bots (two private tables; a round lost when the page dropped to the login screen is not included). Same format as live_logs_v91.json; on the bot's own trades took is T or F followed by R when the trade bought or sold resale stock. live_params are the settings the bot ran with (including the v10 defaults that v11 changed), resale_seed the resale record it carried into the round (hits, misses, own hits, own misses, prices), and resale what its resale trades made: realized $ (cards unsold 45 s after purchase counted as $0), resales that worked and failed, and resale cards still held at the bell.
